statement: A Delaware board of directors (or a board committee) may act without a meeting only by unanimous consent of its members, given in writing or by electronic transmission (8 Del. C. § 141(f)).
caveat: Unanimity is required for board consents; a divided board must act at a meeting. The certificate of incorporation or bylaws can restrict consent action. This repo does not draft or approve consents.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
